title: FlutterFlow Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: FlutterFlow is a mature visual mobile builder with real code export, but it asks you to learn a canvas and wire your own backend. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for describing an app.
body_markdown: Blink. It provisions a managed backend, sign-in, push, and RevenueCat subscriptions from one prompt, includes unlimited team members, and puts an AI gateway inside the apps you ship. More options are compared in our[FlutterFlow alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/flutterflow-alternatives) guide.
